description: The install commands Fileion has for a software title: package-manager commands (winget, Chocolatey, Scoop, Homebrew), silent-install switches, the installer file name and SHA-256, and the Fileion install page. The commands are quoted, never run, and each says where it came from.

slug.description: The title's slug, as search_software returns it, e.g. "vlc-media-player".

name: get_install_command
title: Get install commands
